report_comment.text: NPM1 encodes nucleophosmin, a nucleolar protein involved in ribosome assembly and protein trafficking. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. In a conditional NPM1::ALK mouse model, fusion expression induced lymphoma with activation of MYC- and NOTCH1-associated programs. Dnmt1 deletion prevented lymphoma development despite persistent proximal ALK signaling. Crizotinib has a US indication for children aged at least 1 year and young adults with relapsed or refractory systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.
